text: My daily routine is quite simple, and I try to follow it every day. I usually wake up at seven o'clock and start my morning with a glass of water and a healthy breakfast. After that, I go to work at nine and stay at the office until five in the afternoon. When I finish work, I like to exercise for about an hour, either running or swimming. In the evening, I cook dinner, watch a little TV, and read a book before bed. I believe consistency is important because a good routine helps me stay healthy and feel organized.
